unit.why: A narrative about R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev, who was punished in Heaven for reading the Biur of an unknown heretical author, set inside an anti-heresy exhortation and followed by a non-narrative testimony praising R. Shneur Zalman of Liadi.
unit.boundary_note: The division opens mid-exhortation continued from the previous division, and the closing testimony about the Rav of Liadi is a saying, not a story.

stories.start_quote: שפ"א בהיותו בדרך במלון אור ליום
stories.summary_en: While lodging at an inn on a Thursday night, R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev read a Chumash printed with a new commentary whose author was then still unknown and later proved to be the head of the heretics; Heaven decreed that his prayers would not be accepted for thirty days, and when the period ended he held a feast and told the whole story.

quotes: בהיותו בדרך במלון אור ליום י' עש"ק
tags.why: The event happens while the tsaddik is lodging at an inn on a journey.

quotes: ולקח אצל בעה״ב חומש להשלים הפרשה
tags.why: The innkeeper who supplies the Chumash plays only a peripheral role.

quotes: ולקח אצל בעה״ב חומש להשלים הפרשה
tags.why: He reads the weekly portion together with the commentary.
The reading is part of completing the weekly portion before the Sabbath.

quotes: כי היה ראש האפיקורס כידוע כעת
tags.why: The story concerns a heretical, Haskalah-type author and his book.

quotes: על אשר למד בס׳ שכתבו מין
tags.why: Reading a book written by a heretic is forbidden.

quotes: ונגזר עליו בעולם העליון שלא תתקבל תפלתו שלשים יום
tags.why: Heaven punishes him for the reading.
Whether his prayer is accepted is the core of the punishment.

quotes: ראו האנשים שפניו זועפות ואינו כאתמול שלשום
tags.why: He is visibly downcast during the thirty days.
He celebrates when his prayer is accepted again.

quotes: וסיפר לפני האנשים המכובדים את כל המאורע
tags.why: The tsaddik tells the whole episode to the notables at his feast.

quotes: אשר לא נודע לו מי הוא המחברו
tags.why: Only afterwards is the author known to be a heretic.
He is very afraid that his heart has been spiritually dulled.

quotes: הביטו וראו גודל העונש להמעיין בספריהם
tags.why: The tale is set inside a homiletic warning against heretical books.

missing_concepts: Haskalah / Mendelssohn's Biur as a heretical book
spiritual contamination (timtum ha-lev) from reading heretical works
heavenly decree that a person's prayers will not be accepted
